title: NightWatch Approval Record
description: C04 human approval record accompanying a policy decision (WorkRequest §5.2: decision, reason, approval record, expiry). Identified by approver + scope + time (no dedicated ULID prefix is assigned by the §5.5 prefix table). RUNTIME SEMANTIC: expired approvals are rejected by default, never auto-extended (§22.5.4).
x-nightwatch-runtime-semantics: Expired approvals are rejected, not auto-extended.

scope.description: What the approval covers, e.g. 'issue.publish:finding=find_...' or 'run.execute:environment=production'.

policy_decision_ref.description: Reference to the associated policy decision (e.g. its idempotency key).

evidence_refs.description: References to material the approver reviewed.
